name: audara-studio
description: Make videos from code: a deterministic WebGL/GLSL, three.js and Canvas2D engine with a live browser preview you direct by time and an offline render to MP4, plus a soundtrack skill that turns a song or a script into audio and timing data, a video-ideas skill that helps choose what to make and writes the starting prompt, and a video-repo skill that puts a project in git for someone else to clone and render.
